ORIGIN.quote: Likewise, “OpenAI”, “ChatGPT”, and “Agent” in labels or page titles are self-descriptions, not provider attestations.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that OpenAI-bearing labels exist in the data and that the report has explicitly considered — and then rejected — treating them as evidence of who ran the swarm, reinforced by "Provider attribution ... remain unproven" and the closing refusal of "verified vendor responsibility". This lands in the 0.4 band rather than 0.6 because the report never lets OpenAI stand as a live candidate operator, and rather than 0.2 because it does frame the OpenAI evidence as bearing on provenance before setting it aside.
